headline: Markets snap to reality as chip sell-off and bond yields surge
summary: Recent sell-offs in chip stocks and global bonds, alongside rising oil prices amid geopolitical tension, have prompted investors to reassess risk. Market volatility has increased sharply.
why: Chipmakers and government bond yields are central to equity valuations and interest-rate expectations across global markets.
why_moved: Sell-offs in chip stocks and global bonds, together with higher oil prices amid geopolitical tension, drove a rise in market volatility.
